about: Questions for the answer-grounding eval. Each is answered by rag_answer.py from the top retrieved chunks, then judged. 'answerable' is the drafter's expectation of whether the corpus contains the answer; it is a description of the set, not a label the judge is scored against (the human grades are). Model-drafted; review like the retrieval labels.
